name: GTMOS · Hourly: A-grade accounts → HubSpot (via GTMOS reverse ETL)

parameters.content:
## High-intent accounts → CRM
Hourly: ask GTMOS what the reverse-ETL diff *would* do, and only run the sync when something actually changed — a no-op sync every hour is how CRM audit logs become unreadable.

n8n never touches HubSpot. GTMOS owns the CRM boundary (field mapping, `gtmos_*` ownership, simulated vs live mode), so this schedules GTMOS's own job rather than re-implementing it here.

The outcome of every run is written back to GTMOS as a signed operational record, and a run with failed records ends in **Stop And Error** so the error handler picks it up.

nodes.name: Run now (manual / sub-workflow)
nodes.notes: Lets an operator force a sync out of band: `n8n execute --id=V9xOZgZVTpaEDMPD`. The Server CLI refuses to run a workflow whose only trigger is a Schedule Trigger.
